title: dianthus caryophyllus subsp. gasparrinii
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus subsp. gasparrinii, commonly known as sweet clover carnation or pink carnation, is a subspecies of the carnation plant, known for its delicate pink flowers and distinctive fragrance. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to stimulate the production of vitamin K, which plays a crucial role in blood clotting and bone health. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus caryophyllus subsp. gasparrinii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic properties.
